title: LHC Permissions Capability Ledger
description: Schema for permissions.json — LHC's documentation-only capability ledger. The runtime does not auto-enforce these rules; agents and reviewers read them and must respect the encoded invariants. See skills/shared/read-only-governance.md for the agent-side enforcement contract.

$schema.description: URI reference (absolute or relative) of this schema. Must equal $id below. Relative references resolve against permissions.json's own URI so editors can validate branch-locally before any merge to main.

description.description: Human-readable description of the capability ledger's intent.

internal_writes.description: Default policy for writes inside the working repo and ~/.lhc.

external_writes.description: Default policy for writes to external systems (Jira, Slack, Grafana, DevEx, etc.).

rules.description: Ordered list of permission rules. First-match wins by convention; agents apply them in order.

id.description: Stable, kebab-case identifier for this rule. Used in audit trails.

description.description: Why the rule exists. Reviewer-facing prose.

match.description: Match predicate. At least one of the listed alternatives must be present.

path_prefix.description: Path prefixes the rule applies to. "$CWD" expands to the working repo root, "~/.lhc" expands to the runtime root.

safe_commands.description: Whitelist of commands the rule applies to. Used for read-only Bash.

command_regex.description: Regex to match against the full Bash command line.

effect.description: What the agent does when this rule matches.

unless.description: Free-form prose describing the explicit user-consent clause that overrides this rule. Agents must quote the satisfied 'unless' clause when proceeding.

context_rules.description: Rules that apply only in specific contexts (e.g. inside subagents). Each key is a context name; the value lists additional restrictions.

additional_deny.description: Patterns (server:tool or server:*) that the context further denies on top of inherited rules.

denied_mcp_tools.description: Explicit denylist of MCP server+tool pairs that are forbidden by default. Mirrors the prose denylist in skills/shared/read-only-governance.md and the per-skill SKILL.md files. Agent-enforced documentation; the runtime does not auto-block these calls.

rationale.description: Optional one-line rationale for why this tool is denied.

notes.description: Free-form notes about how this file is interpreted, what the runtime does and does not do, and how agents should override deny rules.
